question: Coal Mines Authority Limited (CMAL) with headquarters at Calcutta, was set up by the Government in May, ______ to manage non-coking coal mines.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1973**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Coal Mines Authority Limited (CMAL)** was established by the **Government of India** in **May 1973**.
 
• It was set up with its **headquarters** located at **Calcutta** (now **Kolkata**) to function as a central authority for the management of **non-coking coal mines**.
 
• The formation of **CMAL** followed the **Coal Mines (Taking Over of Management) Ordinance**, which was promulgated in **January 1973**, leading to the nationalization of **non-coking coal mines**.
 
• The primary objective of creating **CMAL** was to ensure the **scientific development** of coal resources and to provide better **working conditions** and **social security** for the labor force.
 
• It played a transitional role in the Indian coal industry before the various wings of the industry were unified under a single holding company.
